_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47, Monday–Sunday), Dormeo Canada, CAD. Written from that week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 84% to $112.6K on 254 units (116 the week before). Queen led with $47.1K (+51%, 92 units) and King more than doubled to $23.0K (39 units vs 14).
Twin & XL tripled to $15.5K. Sales built through the week: Sunday Nov 22 was the best day at $27.6K.
refunds: Refunds were $2,502 on 8 units (3.3% refund rate), down from $4,978 on 13 units (11.3%) last week. Net payout more than doubled to $67.2K.
pacing_reco: November is at $234.2K through Nov 22, 10% ahead of the same days last year ($213.4K). Keep Queen in stock and deals live through BF/CM.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 31% to $7,608 while ad sales rose 84% to $73,914.
ACoS fell to 10.3% (from 14.5%) and TACoS to 6.8% (from 9.5%); ads drove 66% of revenue.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords brought $45,298 in sales on $3,263 (7.2% ACoS, 110 orders); brand defense added $8,365 at 6.3% ACoS.
Streaming TV spent $909 for $960 in sales (2 orders, 94.7% ACoS).
